snippet.title: Spire Horizon | Open World RPG | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🏮 Our new MMORPG, Lantern Hearth, is coming to Steam. Wishlist it now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5405020/Lantern_Hearth/

Spire Horizon is an open-world RPG where you play as a skeleton hero searching for his beloved wife. Explore a vibrant world, fight fearsome monsters and bosses, and grow stronger with every journey.

▶ Spire Horizon on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2321880/Spire_Horizon/
💬 Discord: https://mendoka.com/discord
📩 News & betas: https://mendoka.com/newsletter

Made by Mendoka, an indie studio from Thailand.

#SpireHorizon #RPG #LanternHearth
